      "severity": "medium",
      "where": "code",

message.content: {"summary":"The screen reads as a stack of six identical outlined pills, which looks like a form rather than a settings menu, repeats the 'App lock' entry, gives the destructive action the same weight as everything else, and clips the bottom tab labels. The biggest win is converting the actions into grouped Paper List.Item rows with leading icons and chevrons, in labelled sections, plus fixing the tab bar and desktop column in shared code.","findings":[{"element":"Settings action list (App lock / Tax settings / Export / Backup & restore / Delete all data / View Terms)","issue":"Six full-width outlined Buttons with centered blue labels look like six primary CTAs; nothing indicates these are navigation targets and the list has no hierarchy.","fix":"Replace the Buttons with Paper <List.Section> groups of <List.Item> inside a shared SettingsGroup card (Surface mode=\"flat\" elevation={1}, borderRadius 12, overflow hidden, no per-row border). Each row: title in bodyLarge/onSurface, left={props => <List.Icon {...props} icon=\"...\"/>} (lock-outline, calculator-variant-outline, tray-arrow-up, cloud-upload-outline, delete-outline, file-document-outline), right={props => <List.Icon {...props} icon=\"chevron-right\"/>}, minHeight 56, horizontal padding 16, and a <Divider/> between rows. Group under List.Subheader labels 'Security', 'Data', 'About' (titleSmall, onSurfaceVariant, paddingTop 24).","shared":true},{"element":"'Delete all data' row","issue":"Destructive action is styled identically to every other item (same blue label, same pill), so it is easy to hit by mistake.","fix":"Put it alone in the last group and render title + left icon with theme.colors.error (titleStyle={{color: theme.colors.error}}, List.Icon color={theme.colors.error}, icon=\"delete-outline\"), no chevron; keep the existing confirm dialog.","shared":false},{"element":"Bottom navigation bar","issue":"Tab labels 'Dashboard/Receipts/Mileage/Settings' are cut off at the bottom on the 390x844 frame — the bar has no safe-area bottom inset.","fix":"In the shared tab navigator, set tabBarStyle={{height: 56 + insets.bottom, paddingBottom: insets.bottom, paddingTop: 8}} using useSafeAreaInsets(), tabBarLabelStyle={{fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 16, marginTop: 4}}, and add a top hairline with theme.colors.outlineVariant.","shared":true},{"element":"Duplicate 'App lock' entry (toggle card + list row)","issue":"App lock appears twice — as a Switch card and as a navigation row — which is confusing and wastes the most prominent slot.","fix":"Keep only one: remove the standalone 'App lock' button row and keep the toggle, moved into the 'Security' group as a <List.Item> with right={() => <Switch value={...} onValueChange={...}/>} and description=\"Require biometric authentication on launch\".","shared":false},{"element":"App lock card description text","issue":"The secondary line renders in teal/primary color, so supporting text competes with interactive elements and breaks the color system.","fix":"Set description/supporting text to variant=\"bodyMedium\" with color theme.colors.onSurfaceVariant; in theme.ts ensure Text defaults and List.Item descriptionStyle use onSurfaceVariant, reserving primary strictly for interactive labels.","shared":true},{"element":"Screen header and page container (phone + desktop)","issue":"'Settings' is an oversized bold heading glued to the top edge on phone, and on desktop the content is a 390px column centered against a 1280px tab bar, leaving it stranded.","fix":"Use the shared ScreenContainer: paddingHorizontal 16, paddingTop 24, title as <Text variant=\"headlineMedium\"> with marginBottom 16; set content wrapper to {width:'100%', maxWidth: 720, alignSelf:'center'} and increase paddingHorizontal to 24 at width >= 900 so the list fills a readable column on desktop.","shared":true}]}

# DEPLOYMENT.md

*This guide takes John (or any developer) from the first‑commit version of **apps/freelance‑finance‑tracker** to a production‑ready iOS/Android release (with an optional web fallback). All commands, file names, ports, and environment variables are taken from the repository; anything that does not yet exist is marked **TODO** and a stub is provided.*

---  

## What this app is

- **Type**: Mobile‑first, local‑first finance tracker built with **Expo SDK** `$(npm view expo version)` (the exact version is pinned in `package.json`).  
- **Core story**: Users capture receipt photos + metadata and mileage logs, view a dashboard, and export tax‑ready CSV/PDF files—all data stays encrypted on‑device. No network traffic, no analytics, no accounts.  
- **Key features (source files)**  
  1. **Policy gate** – `src/lib/policy.ts` stores `POLICY_VERSION` acceptance in encrypted storage and blocks the UI until the user agrees.  
  2. **Encrypted storage** – `src/lib/storage/device.native.ts` uses SQLite + `expo-secure-store` for the encryption key (generated on first launch).  
  3. **Receipt capture** – `expo-image-picker` + `expo-file-system` (`src/lib/photoPicker.ts`, `src/components/ui/ReceiptImagePicker.tsx`).  
  4. **Mileage logging** – configurable IRS rate (`src/lib/settings.ts`).  
  5. **Exports** – CSV (`src/lib/exportCsv.ts`) and PDF (`src/lib/exportPdf.ts` via `expo-print`).  
  6. **Encrypted backup / restore** – `src/lib/backup.ts` uses `@noble/ciphers` & `@noble/hashes`.  
  7. **Optional biometric lock** – `src/lib/appLock.ts` (`expo-local-authentication`), toggleable in Settings.  
  8. **Theming & UI** – React Native Paper (Material 3) with shared components under `src/components/ui/`.  
- **Entry point** – `src/App.tsx` mounts the policy gate, optional app lock, and the bottom‑tab navigator (`src/navigation/index.tsx`).  

---  

## Architecture

```
+-------------------+      +------------------------+      +-------------------+
|  React Native UI  | ---> |  Domain / Lib layer    | ---> |  Encrypted Store  |
| (Paper, Nav, FAB) |      | (pure‑logic only)      |      | (expo‑sqlite)     |
+-------------------+      +------------------------+      +-------------------+
        |                         |                              |
        v                         v                              v
   Expo runtime            src/lib/*.ts                expo-secure-store
   (iOS / Android)         (finance, receipt …)           (key)
```

- **UI layer** – screens in `src/screens/` and primitives in `src/components/ui/`.  
- **Domain layer** – pure functions (`src/lib/finance.ts`, `src/lib/mileage.ts`, `src/lib/backup.ts`, …) fully unit‑testable.  
- **Storage layer** – `src/lib/storage/` abstracts encrypted SQLite on native (`device.native.ts`) and a plain fallback for `expo start --web` (`device.web.ts`).  
- **Policy gate** – `src/screens/PolicyScreen.tsx` checks `POLICY_VERSION` before any other navigator renders.  
- **No backend** – the only external interaction is OTA updates via EAS.  

---  

## Prerequisites

| Tool | Version / Install command |
|------|---------------------------|
| **Node.js** | `>=20`  `node -v` |
| **npm** | `>=10`  `npm -v` |
| **Expo CLI** | `npm i -g expo-cli` |
| **EAS CLI** (Expo Application Services) | `npm i -g eas-cli` |
| **Apple Developer account** | Required for iOS signing |
| **Google Play Console account** | Required for Android signing |
| **Java JDK 11+** (Android builds) | `brew install openjdk@11` (macOS) |
| **Xcode 15+** (iOS builds) | Required on macOS |
| **Git** | `git --version` |
| **Docker** (optional – only for the optional web fallback) | `docker --version` |

> **NOTE**: Inside `apps/freelance-finance-tracker` run `npm view expo version` to verify the SDK version matches the one in `package.json`.

---  

## Configuration and secrets

| Item | Where it lives | How to set / update |
|------|----------------|---------------------|
| **Expo app config** | `app.json` | Edit `expo.name`, `expo.slug`, `expo.version`, `expo.orientation`, etc. |
| **Policy version** | `src/lib/policy.ts` – `export const POLICY_VERSION = "1.0.0"` | Bump the constant whenever the policy text changes. |

- [ ] **Backup‑passphrase brute‑force (medium)** – Implement exponential back‑off after each failed restore attempt (1 s, 2 s, 4 s, …) and lock the restore UI after **5** consecutive failures. Store the failure count in memory (reset on app restart).  
- [ ] **CSV export injection (medium)** – Replace the custom prefix logic with a robust CSV generation library such as `csv-stringify` that fully escapes commas, quotes, newlines, and leading characters per RFC 4180.  
- [ ] **Backup temporary file cleanup (medium)** – Ensure `src/lib/backup.ts` deletes the temporary file in a `finally` block using `FileSystem.deleteAsync(tmpUri, { idempotent: true })`.
